channel.title: FXStreet Forex & Commodities News
channel.description: Real-time Forex News and the latest trading updates. Stay updated on the latest news about currencies and commodities markets.

item.title: US Dollar: Q3 uptrend seen intact – TD Securities
item.description: TD Securities’ macro team, led by Jayati Bharadwaj and colleagues, argues that recent Dollar weakness after the July FOMC is a short-lived retracement within a broader Q3 2026 USD uptrend.

item.title: Indian Rupee surrenders mild gains after RBI's policy decision
item.description: The Indian Rupee (INR) surrenders mild gains after a strong opening against the US Dollar (USD), following the Reserve Bank of India’s (RBI) monetary policy decision.

item.title: Experts agree: US-Japan intervention to boost Yen won't last long
item.description: The British Pound (GBP) claws back its early losses against the Japanese Yen (JPY) and edges higher to near 212.25 during the European trading session on Wednesday.

item.title: WTI Price Forecast: Edges lower to near $74.50 with bearish bias intact below 100-day SMA
item.description: West Texas Intermediate (WTI), the US crude oil benchmark, is trading around $74.50 during the early European trading hours on Wednesday. WTI declines on mixed US-Iran messages.

item.title: British Pound: Consolidation with limited upside scope against US Dollar – UOB
item.description: United Overseas Bank’s (UOB) Quek Ser Leang and Lee Sue Ann analysts report GBP/USD traded quietly between 1.3423 and 1.3456 after a prior spike to 1.3506. They expect near‑term consolidation in a 1.3425–1.3470 band.

item.title: Euro holds gains against the Pound awaiting Eurozone and UK Services PMIs
item.description: The Euro (EUR) remains practically flat against the British Pound (GBP) on Wednesday, trading at 0.8573 at the time of writing and holding gains from the last two days after bouncing from the 0.8540 area on Friday.

item.title: Japanese Yen: Joint action fails to secure lasting gains – Commerzbank
item.description: Commerzbank’s Thu Lan Nguyen argues that the recent historic intervention in USD/JPY, powered by US Treasury participation, may not secure a lasting Japanese Yen (JPY) recovery.

item.title: Gold extends gains to one-month top as traders pare Fed rate hike bets on Iran hopes
item.description: Gold (XAU/USD) builds on its strong intraday positive move and jumps to a nearly one-month high around $4,180 heading into the European session on Wednesday.

item.title: Forex Today: US Dollar struggles as risk flows dominate markets
item.description: Here is what you need to know on Wednesday, August 5:

item.title: Equities: Rally extends on reduced downside fears – Danske Bank
item.description: Danske Research Team describes a strong global equities session driven by reduced downside risks rather than upgraded growth expectations. Easing concerns over the Iran conflict and the AI bubble compressed risk premia, lifting global equities close to a 15% year‑to‑date return.

item.title: Oil: Market looks through Hormuz risks – MUFG
item.description: Michael Wan at MUFG notes Brent has dropped below US$80 as hopes rise for a deal to reopen the Strait of Hormuz.

item.title: British Pound grinds higher above 1.3450 ahead of US ADP Employment release
item.description: The GBP/USD pair posts modest gains near 1.3455 during the early European session on Wednesday, bolstered by softer US economic data and cooling US-Iran tensions. Traders brace for the US ADP Employment and ISM Services Purchasing Manager Index (PMI) reports, which are due on Wednesday.

item.title: US Dollar Index Price Forecast: Bears eye two-month lows around 99.40
item.description: The US Dollar Index (DXY) edges lower for the second consecutive day on Wednesday, after failing to consolidate above the 100.00 level on Monday.

item.title: Euro: Mild upside toward 1.1565 cap against US Dollar – UOB
item.description: United Overseas Bank’s (UOB) Quek Ser Leang and Lee Sue Ann highlights that EUR/USD firmed to 1.1529, with short‑term momentum turning slightly higher. They see scope for the Euro to edge up but doubt an intraday break of 1.1565, with 1.1545 as nearer resistance and 1.1515/1.1500 as supports.

item.title: AUD/USD Price Forecast: Steadies around 0.7050 as bullish bias prevails
item.description: AUD/USD moves little after registering over 0.5% gains in the previous day, trading around 0.7050 during the Asian hours on Wednesday. The technical analysis of the daily chart shows that the pair is remaining within the ascending channel pattern, suggesting a prevailing bullish bias.

item.title: EUR/USD Price Forecast: Hawkish ECB bets back fresh upside
item.description: The Euro (EUR) trades marginally higher at around 1.1536 against the US Dollar (USD) during the European trading session on Wednesday.

item.title: New Zealand Dollar weakens below 0.5900 as Unemployment Rate jumps to highest since 2015
item.description: The NZD/USD pair weakens to near 0.5870 during the early European trading hours on Wednesday. The New Zealand Dollar attracts some sellers against the US Dollar (USD) after New Zealand’s unemployment rate climbs to the highest in 11 years.

item.title: Indonesian Rupiah remains stronger on strong domestic GDP
item.description: USD/IDR depreciates after registering minor gains in the previous day, trading around 17,970 during the Asian hours on Wednesday. The currency pair is under downward pressure as a combination of strong Indonesian economic performance and softening US Dollar (USD) demand weighs on the pair.

item.title: USD/JPY Price Forecast: Holds steady above 157.50 as bulls await 50-hour EMA breakout
item.description: The USD/JPY pair drifts lower during the Asian session on Wednesday and, for now, seems to have stalled this week's goodish recovery from the 155.25-155.20 region, or the lowest since May.

item.title: RBI keeps the Repo Rate unchanged at 5.25% in August, as expected
item.description: The Reserve Bank of India’s (RBI) Monetary Policy Committee (MPC) announced on Wednesday that it held the benchmark Repo Rate steady at 5.25% following the conclusion of the August monetary policy meeting.

item.title: Swiss Franc gains as easing risk aversion weighs on US Dollar
item.description: USD/CHF extends its losses for the second successive day, trading around 0.8080 during the Asian hours on Wednesday.

item.title: India Gold price today: Gold rises, according to FXStreet data
item.description: Gold prices rose in India on Wednesday, according to data compiled by FXStreet.

item.title: Canadian Dollar hangs near one-week low as weak oil prices counter USD downtick
item.description: The USD/CAD pair trades with a positive bias for the fourth straight day and currently hovers around the 1.4070 region, or a nearly one-week high set the previous day.

item.title: EUR/JPY Price Forecast: Softens below 182.00 on intervention risks, bearish outlook prevails
item.description: The EUR/JPY cross trades in negative territory around 181.70 during the early European trading hours on Wednesday.

item.title: US President Donald Trump: We're having very productive talks with Iran
item.description: US President Donald Trump said that he had very productive talks with Iran, Fox News reported on Wednesday.

item.title: Silver Price Forecast: XAG/USD revisits monthly high near $61 as oil price plunges further
item.description: Silver price (XAG/USD) trades 1.8% higher at around $60.95 during the Asian trading session on Wednesday.

item.title: WTI slips below $74.00 as Hormuz talks progress, US stocks rise
item.description: West Texas Intermediate (WTI) oil price falls after paring its daily gains, trading around $73.80 per barrel during the Asian hours on Wednesday.

item.title: US nears Hormuz deal, aiming for Wednesday announcement – Axios
item.description: According to a report from Axios, the United States (US), Iran, and Oman are closing in on an interim agreement to reopen the Strait of Hormuz, with the U.S. aiming for a Wednesday announcement, sources said.

item.title: Japan’s Kihara: Specific monetary policy means are up to the BoJ to decide
item.description: Japanese Chief Cabinet Secretary Minoru Kihara said on Wednesday, “specific monetary policy means are up to the Bank of Japan (BoJ) to decide.”

item.title: United States Dollar Index declines amid easing safe-haven demand
item.description: The US Dollar Index (DXY), which measures the value of the US Dollar (USD) against six major currencies, is extending its losses for the second successive day and trading around 99.90 during the Asian session on Wednesday.
